name: Sonnet concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Concentrated long AI-infrastructure book re-entering GPU, memory, networking and hyperscale leaders after the early-November stop-outs, with 30% cash kept in reserve.
reassessment_note: Four of five legs were stopped out in early November and the book sat mostly in cash through a +5.6% SPY rebound week. Search found only thin, undated coverage (chip sector recovering after the October selloff, analysts bullish on memory), so this rests mainly on the packet and the rebound. I redeploy roughly 70% into the same mandate with sizing below the prior concentration and wider stops, keep MSFT, and hold 30% cash because the stop-outs show volatility is high.

positions.thesis: Existing hyperscale-cloud leg, roughly flat (-1.6%), the only holding that survived the selloff; it is kept at its prior size as the lower-volatility anchor.
GPU compute leader, stopped out near 181.6 and coverage calls it a relative laggard. Re-entering at 20%, below the prior 28%, after the rebound confirms demand without doubling down.
Server CPU and accelerator share gains with a strong guidance narrative. Sized at 12% (prior 20%) because it was stopped out on high beta.
Memory is the tightest AI bottleneck and analyst targets were raised sharply. Stopped out near 833, so re-entering at 13% with a wide stop.
Custom-silicon and networking exposure that diversifies away from GPUs. Sized at 10% after a stop-out on soft AI guidance.
